verdict.rationale: Formant documents commands that make a robot run scripts or publish ROS topics, an Admin API for defining custom commands, and APIs plus a RealtimeSDK for building custom applications. This suggests programmatic robot control is possible, but the evidence only shows commands being sent by button click, teleop or events, not explicitly through the API. missing for 10: scoped credentials or service-account authentication for an AI agent, explicit API/SDK calls that dispatch commands to a real robot, a documented end-to-end agent workflow, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an AI agent authenticate with scoped credentials and command a real robot end-to-end through the platform's API or SDK

citations.quote: you can create custom commands via the Formant Admin API
`formant.publish_ros_topic` Publish a message to a ROS topic. `formant.run_script` Run a script on the device.
